BULK_RUNNING_NOTE: {n} running game(s) will be refused — the rest are applied
NO_PROFILES_YET: No profiles saved yet — create one from [Apply / save per game] › a game › save profile
CHECKIN_MANY: For {n} game(s), what the settings file held before the change was also saved into the previous profile
QAM_ABOUT: Games don't change their graphics settings by themselves when you plug or unplug an eGPU.
QAM_ABOUT_GUIDE: This tool keeps two profiles per game ({dock}/{internal}) and swaps them all at once.
OPEN_DISCOVER_DESC: Finds graphics settings files in your installed games and registers them
OPEN_GAMES_DESC: Saves a profile per game and applies them one at a time
POPUP_DISCOVER_MODAL_FAILED: Could not open the “Detect games” screen — nothing was changed
POPUP_GAMES_MODAL_FAILED: Could not open the “Apply / save per game” screen — nothing was changed
POPUP_SETTINGS_MODAL_FAILED: Could not open the “Settings” screen — nothing was changed
NO_GAMES: No games are registered — you can add them from [Detect games]
UI_CHECK_FAILED: Some UI components were not found ({missing}) — see the logs
APPLY_PROBLEM_REFUSED: {names} — running, so nothing was applied there; close them and try again
SAVE_CONFIRM_BODY: This overwrites what was previously saved in this profile.
SAVE_CONFIRM_INCOMING: Will be saved:  the game's current config file — {state}
SAVE_CONFIRM_BACKUP_LIMIT: The previous profile is kept as a backup, but it drops off the backup list after roughly {n} more applies for this game.
DISK_STATE_UNKNOWN: different from every profile (looks like it was changed in-game)
DISK_STATE_LOOKUP_FAILED: the config file could not be read
SAVE_CONFIRM_MODAL_FAILED: Could not open the confirmation dialog — nothing was saved.
PATH_IS_SYMLINK: The config path is a symbolic link, so it was refused for safety
PATH_OUTSIDE_PREFIX: The config file is outside this game's Proton prefix — only files inside …/steamapps/compatdata/<appid>/pfx/… can be registered
PATH_OUTSIDE_HOME: This game's Proton prefix was not found and the file is outside your home folder
NOT_REGULAR_FILE: That path is not a regular file
FILE_EMPTY: The config file is empty (0 bytes)
SIZE_OUT_OF_RANGE: The config file's size differs too much from when the profile was saved, so nothing was changed — a game update may have restructured it. Check your settings in-game, then save the profile again to refresh the baseline.
LINE_COUNT_OUT_OF_RANGE: The config file's line count differs too much from when the profile was saved, so nothing was changed — a game update may have restructured it. Check your settings in-game, then save the profile again to refresh the baseline.
CONFIG_MISSING: The game's config file doesn't exist — running the game once and opening its graphics settings usually creates it. If it still doesn't appear, pick the file again from [Detect games].
PROFILE_MISSING: This profile has not been saved yet
PROFILE_CORRUPT: This saved profile doesn't match its records and may be damaged — save the profile again for this game, or bring back an earlier version from [Restore backup].
GAME_RUNNING: The game is running; close it completely and try again
BACKUP_FAILED: The backup failed, so nothing was changed
REGISTRY_UNREADABLE: Couldn't read the plugin's game list — toggle the plugin off and on to retry. If this persists the list file is damaged. Your saved profiles and backups are intact, and an automatic backup of the previous list is kept alongside it.
REGISTRY_MALFORMED: The plugin's game list is damaged. Your saved profiles and backups are intact, and an automatic backup of the previous list is kept alongside it.
SAV_REFUSED: Save files are never touched by this plugin
STALE_COPY_REFUSED: That file is an old copy inside a backup folder
ENGINE_BOILERPLATE_REFUSED: That is a game engine's internal file, not a settings file
BACKUP_OUT_OF_ROOT: That path is outside this game's backup folder
DELETE_FAILED: Unregistering stopped partway through — run it again to finish it
BACKUP_ID_INVALID: That backup id is not valid
PROFILE_META_CORRUPT: The profile information could not be read
ALREADY_REGISTERED: This game is already registered — remove it first if you need to point it at a different file
UNEXPECTED: Unexpected error — please try again. If it persists, the cause is recorded in the plugin log under Decky settings.
WARN_OUTSIDE_SCAN_ROOTS: This file is outside the folders where game settings normally live
WARN_NOT_DISCOVER_CANDIDATE: Auto-detection did not suggest this file
DISCOVER_ADD_CONFIDENT: Add all {n} game(s) whose config file was found
DISCOVER_BADGE_AMBIGUOUS: {n} candidate(s) — pick the right one yourself
DISCOVER_NONE_FOUND: Auto-detection found nothing — that does not mean you have no games. It only looks inside Proton prefixes (…/steamapps/compatdata/<appid>/pfx/…). Native Linux games keep their settings outside any prefix, so this plugin cannot register them at all right now — not even with the button below, because it works out which game a file belongs to from the prefix path. If a Proton game was missed, use the button below to pick its config file inside that game's prefix. Otherwise, check that the game has been run at least once.
DISCOVER_NONE_UNREGISTERED: Every detected game is already registered
DISCOVER_WARN_TITLE: Is this the right file for {name}?
DISCOVER_WARN_BODY: Not registered yet. Auto-detection would not have suggested this file. Nothing has been written anywhere — cancel and nothing happens.
DISCOVER_MANUAL_NO_APPID: That file is not inside a game's Proton prefix (…/steamapps/compatdata/<number>/pfx/…), so there is no way to tell which game it belongs to. Nothing was registered. Files outside a prefix — including the settings of native Linux games — cannot be registered.
DISCOVER_WARN_MODAL_FAILED: Could not show the confirmation — nothing was registered. Try picking the file again.
DISCOVER_EXCLUDED_HINT: These are games you unregistered in this plugin. They no longer appear in the automatic detection list. [Put back] makes a game show up as a candidate again (when it is installed and has a config file).
DISCOVER_INCLUDED_NOTE: {name} is no longer excluded — add it from the detection list under [Back]. If it does not show up there, you can register it with [Pick a file…].
DISCOVER_INCLUDE_FAILED: Could not put this game back ({code})
DISCOVER_PICK_FILE_DESC: Pick the game's graphics config file yourself (usually inside …/compatdata/<number>/pfx/…).
DISCOVER_ADDED_HAS_BACKUPS: Added “{name}” — {n} earlier backup(s) remain. Restore them from [Apply/save per game] → this game's › → [Restore backup].
MANAGE_KEEP_CONFIG: The game's own settings file is never touched.
MANAGE_MODAL_FAILED: Could not show the confirmation — nothing was deleted.
DELETE_CONFIRM_BODY: This removes the registration and the saved profiles for this game.
DELETE_CONFIRM_BACKUP: The profiles are copied to backups first, and the backups stay after unregistering (this game has {n} backup(s) right now).
RESET_ZONE_BODY: Full reset — deletes {n} registration(s) and every saved profile. Backups are kept.
RESET_HINT: Backups are kept, and the games' own settings files are never touched.
RESET_CONFIRM_BODY: {games} registration(s) and {profiles} saved profile(s) will be deleted.
RESET_CONFIRM_BACKUP_KEPT: Backups are kept, so a just-deleted profile can still be recovered from them.
BACKUP_LIST_HINT: Restoring only rewrites the game's settings file. Your saved profiles stay as they are.
BACKUP_KIND_DISK: Automatic backup taken just before an apply or restore (the game's settings file)
BACKUP_KIND_PROFILE: Earlier content pushed out of the {profile} profile
RESTORE_CONFIRM_BODY: The game's settings file will be overwritten with the backup from {stamp}.
RESTORE_CONFIRM_CURRENT: What gets overwritten (the settings file now): {state}
RESTORE_CONFIRM_BACKUP: The game's settings file as it is now is copied to backups first — that uses one backup slot, so the oldest backup may be pushed out.
RESTORE_CONFIRM_SLOT_NOTE: Your saved profiles are not changed — only the settings file is rewritten.
RESTORE_OK: Restored the settings file from the {stamp} backup
RESTORE_OK_MANUAL: Restored from the {stamp} backup — this content is only in the game's settings file right now. The next apply puts the profile's content back, so save it as this game's profile to keep it.
RESTORE_ALREADY: The settings file already matches this backup — nothing was changed
RESTORE_FOLLOWUP_TITLE: Save it into the profile too?
RESTORE_FOLLOWUP_BODY: The restored content is only in the game's settings file right now. Save it into the {profile} profile as well so that later applies use it.
APPLY_ALL_CONFIRM_TITLE: Apply the “{profile}” profile to your games?
APPLY_ALL_CONFIRM_BODY: This swaps the settings file of {total} registered game(s) to the “{profile}” profile.
APPLY_CONFIRM_MODAL_FAILED: Could not show the confirmation — nothing was applied.
MANAGE_NAMES_HINT: This changes only the name shown on screen. Saved profiles and backups stay exactly where they are.
NAME_EDIT_HINT: Leave it empty to go back to the default name ({fallback}). Up to {max} characters are stored.
NAME_EDIT_RESET_NOTE: Display name reset to the default
RESET_CONFIRM_NAMES: The {n} display name(s) you set will also go back to the defaults.
RESTORE_MODAL_FAILED: Could not show the confirmation — nothing was restored.
RESTORE_FOLLOWUP_MODAL_FAILED: The game's settings file was restored. However the follow-up question about saving it into a profile could not be shown — save it with this game's profile save.
NAME_EDIT_MODAL_FAILED: Could not show the rename dialog. The name is unchanged.
RESTORE_CONFIRM_SLOT_ASK: Your saved profiles are not changed. After restoring you will be asked whether to put the content into this profile as well.
FILTER_NO_PROFILE_ONLY: Show only games without a profile
GAMES_EXCLUDED_NOTE: {n} game(s) excluded from detection — you can see them under “Excluded games” in [Detect games]
GAME_DETAIL_DIVERGED: Right now: different from every saved profile
PROFILES_IDENTICAL: By their saved records, both profiles hold the same content.
SAVE_GUIDE: Set the game's graphics options the way you want them for {dock}, then press [Save {dock} profile]; do the same for {internal} and press [Save {internal} profile].
SAVE_DESC: Saves what is in the game's settings file right now into this profile
SAVE_DESC_RUNNING: This game is running — whatever is on disk right now is what gets saved (a game that rewrites on exit may end up with different values)
OPEN_BACKUPS_DESC: Goes back to earlier content when you saved the wrong thing or the game's settings file got broken
UNREGISTER_GAME_DESC: Removes only this plugin's registration and its saved profiles (copied to backups first). The game's own settings file is never touched.
CHECKIN_ONE: What the game's settings file held until a moment ago was also saved into the {profile} profile — its previous content is in the backups
BACKUP_LIST_ORDER_HINT: Newest first — what was just pushed out is near the top
BACKUP_RING_HINT: As you keep applying and saving, the oldest backups drop off
BACKUP_LIST_FOLLOWUP_HINT: Whether to put it back into a profile is asked after restoring
DELETE_CONFIRM_REDISCOVER: Unregistering also excludes the game from automatic detection. To use it again, put it back from “Excluded games” in [Detect games] or pick its file yourself — once it is registered again you can restore its profiles from the backups that remain.
RESET_LEFT_NOTE: {left} could not be deleted — running the reset again continues with what is left
RESET_CONFIRM_WARN: ⚠ {games} registration(s) and {profiles} profile(s) will be deleted. Backups are kept, but to bring one back you must register that game again and then restore it from a backup.
RESET_CONFIRM_EXCLUDED: The detection-exclusion list is cleared as well ({n})
